boone-county-public-library-walton-branc.text: BCPL says Walton offers hearing loops for patrons with hearing aids or cochlear implants during programs. Confirm the room and equipment arrangements before attending.
boone-county-public-library-walton-branc.quote: For patrons with hearing aids or cochlear implants, the Walton Branch offers hearing loops to assist during programs, with plans to expand the service to additional locations.
boone-county-public-library-walton-branc.reason: Made the source's intended equipment users and program scope explicit; no room coverage or device compatibility is inferred.

boone-county-public-library-hebron-branc.text: BCPL says Hebron has a computer desk that raises and lowers at the push of a button. It describes its buildings as having wide aisles and allows borrowed wheelchairs inside and on library grounds, including the Hebron Storywalk; route measurements are not supplied.
quote: The Hebron Branch has a height-adjustable computer desk that can be raised or lowered with the press of a button, and accessible computer stations are coming soon to the Florence Branch.
Visitors can use the wheelchairs throughout our wide-aisle buildings as well as our outside property, such as the Storywalk at our Hebron location or the patio at the Walton Branch.
boone-county-public-library-hebron-branc.reason: Attributed the unmeasured wide-aisle description and separated permission to use equipment from a measured route assessment.
